verdict.line: You lose if you contest flat trades once Renekton's Fury passes 50, you win if you force fights after his E (Slice and Dice) is down.

brief.thesis: This matchup is a resource check, not a kit check: Renekton's Q, W, and E all get stronger once his Fury bar crosses 50, so the lane is even at baseline but swings hard toward him in any trade where he's already topped off on Fury. K'Sante's W (Path Maker) charge-up grants damage reduction before the stun lands, which is the one tool that directly answers Renekton's W (Ruthless Predator) stun-lock. The 47.5% win rate over 2077 games and K'Sante's solo-kill edge both point to the same read: you win by controlling when the fight happens, not by out-damaging him in a straight exchange.

theirWindow.when: Fury over 50 and W off cooldown
theirWindow.what: His W (Ruthless Predator) becomes a 3-hit, 1.5s stun that strips shields, and his Q (Cull the Meek) heals and hits harder — do not extend a trade into this, back out and let the proc fall off.

yourWindow.when: Right after his E (Slice and Dice) is used
yourWindow.what: Slice and Dice is on a 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s cooldown and is his only gap-closer/escape — once it's down, step in with Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks and E (Footwork) shield; he has no way to disengage from your follow-up.

powerCurve.note: Neither has empowered abilities or Fury built up yet
W cooldown drops to 12s, Fury-fueled all-ins hit hard
Your R (All Out) and Path Maker ranks catch up
Bramble/Jak'Sho tankiness outlasts his Fury burst

start.why: Highest measured win rate (47.6% over 2098 games) and by far the most picked start (87.1%) in this matchup — it holds up better than Doran's Shield against Renekton's burst-stun trades rather than his sustained poke.

boots.why: 76.8% pick rate and the stronger of the two win rates (45.6% over 1761 games) — Renekton's damage is almost entirely auto-attacks and on-hit slashes, which Steelcaps directly reduces.

core.why: Cuts into the heal on his Q (Cull the Meek), which is the main thing keeping him in extended trades once Fury is high
Pairs with Q (Ntofo Strikes)'s short-line slow to lock him in range for your follow-up stack and pull
Stacking resistances scale through the whole game and keep you ahead of his Fury-scaling damage late
Highest win rate order in the data (59.3% over 54 games) — grievous wounds shuts down his Q heal entirely in a long fight

situational.when: he or his team is building toward sustained poke or healing you need to cut into
you're ahead and need a burst shield to tank his all-in at level 6 with Dominus up
their bot lane or jungle brings heavy CC you need to play around in lane

runes.keystoneWhy: Most-picked page in the data (22.6% pick) — Grasp rewards the slow, repeated trades this lane is built around rather than a burst all-in you're not favored to win

summoners.why: 77.4% pick rate and the best win rate of the three combos (47%) — this is an even, scaling lane with no early kill threat either direction, so Teleport's wave and tempo value outweighs Ignite's kill pressure.

playing.title: Trade before Fury hits 50
playing.detail: Renekton's Q and W both step up in damage once his Fury bar crosses 50. Initiate short trades with Q (Ntofo Strikes) early in the wave and disengage before he's topped off.

playing.title: Charge W into his stun
playing.detail: W (Path Maker)'s charge-up grants reduced damage before the dash fires — hold the charge when you expect his W (Ruthless Predator) stun rather than eating it unmitigated.

playing.title: Punish after his E is down
playing.detail: Slice and Dice is his only dash, on a 16-10s cooldown depending on rank. The moment it's used to clear a wave or engage, he has no way out of your E (Footwork) shield plus Q stack-and-pull.

playing.title: Stack Q for the pull, not just damage
playing.detail: Two stacks of Q (Ntofo Strikes) fire a shockwave that pulls him in — use this to drag him off his E dash path instead of just adding poke damage.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Dominus
playing.detail: His R transforms him into a tankier AoE burst form and refills Fury passively while active. Don't extend a trade into his ult window; wait for it to end before re-engaging.

playing.title: Use All Out to end fights, not start them
playing.detail: Your R (All Out) knocks him through terrain and transforms your kit for increased damage and healing at reduced defenses — save it to finish a trade you already won, not to open one cold.

playing.title: Itemize Bramble/Thornmail on curve
playing.detail: His Q heal and Fury sustain are the reason longer trades favor him early — rushing Bramble Vest into Thornmail removes that advantage by mid-game.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the timing reads, power spikes, and trade patterns are my own analysis of the ability kits, not measured data.
